mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN TON.ISUSEDEFAULT = 0 THEN TAI.NODEFAULTCODE ELSE TON.NOCODE END AS CODE , CASE WHEN TON.ISUSEDEFAULT = 0 THEN TAI.NODEFAULTSEPARTOR ELSE TON.NOSEPARTOR END AS SEP, CASE WHEN TON.ISUSEDEFAULT = 0 THEN TAI.NODEFAULTNUMBER ELSE TON.NONUMBER END AS NUMBER1 FROM TBL_AUTONO_INFO TAI LEFT JOIN TBL_ORG_NO TON ON TAI.NOID = TON.NOID WHERE TON.ORGID =#{orgid} AND TON.NOID =#{NoId}

select STATUS, count(*) as num from TBL_ASSESS where 1=1
and tblcomany in
#{item}
or tblcomany =#{queryParam.orgid} group by STATUS
